messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: Structure matrix for AR1
parts:
The structure matrix does not depend on the covariate. Whether you use AR1 as a temporal model, a spatial 1 dimensional effect, or some nonlinear covariate effect, the structure matrix is the same.

Kind regards,
